about: Design update for the ports-core deploy: per account (username), what each saved ship becomes. A slot or design maps to a blueprint id under data/ships/blueprints (dev/... for the hand-made player remakes, which the deploy tarball leaves out: the migration must carry them; a bare id for a stock library ship). 'wipe' means the account takes the v5 ship wipe (ships broken down and refunded, a fresh starter). 'was' is the save each remake was made from (name and part count, from production on 2026-11-07): a save that no longer matches has changed since and should be wiped, not swapped. Slots are 0-based hangar indices; designs are indices into the profile's designs list. Anything not listed here is wiped.
